_why: Frozen reference outputs from the C engine, captured 2026-08-12 before the non-Rust tree was deleted. These ARE the oracle: rust-golden used to assert byte-identity against a C binary, and once that binary is gone the only way to keep the contract is to have written its answers down first.
c_logits: c_logits.bin (1024 B, f32 little-endian, the whole-stack logits for gen 1)
